integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite verifier checks are corroborative only. Literature comparison used the primary paper, broader Agmon-Finsler literature, low-dimensional resolvent literature, and targeted formula/alias searches; an unindexed equivalent formulation remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a sharp convex-geometric comparison for the constant-energy Agmon support norm. It does not assert realization of every extremal rate by an eigenfunction for an arbitrary potential. In dimension one the two constants coincide.
title: Sharp Euclidean anisotropy constants for the lattice Agmon–Finsler norm
